label: PF Backlog 655
title: Review tooling: delta-only re-reviews, prior findings, design pack + encoding gates

brief.problem: 1484 finalization still has edge-case hardening after multiple 2.5 reviews.
brief.what_adds: Follow-up hardening for completion/report invariants, approval ergonomics and scope.
brief.why_now: Track the residual work without blocking the finalization delivery.
brief.success: Residual findings closed or accepted with evidence.

objective: Make re-reviews review only the delta since the last reviewed HEAD, with prior findings/dispositions and full-candidate AC context; add the per-item design pack and encoding gate without 1484 finalization code.
acceptance_criteria: Re-reviews diff last_reviewed_HEAD..HEAD, include prior findings/dispositions and full-candidate AC evidence, and bind evidence to base/head; a data-only commit does not invalidate the review.

Design pack: item.design_pack + generated engineering/design/<ID>.md; Gate 1 and precheck validate enforced items (requirements, invariants, contracts, failure matrix, dependencies, security, observability, performance, test matrix, rollout/rollback, decisions).
Encoding gate: changed source/config/docs must be UTF-8 without BOM, including working-tree/untracked files; generator reads templates BOM-safely.
Tests cover delta base/prior context, design-pack check/render/config, and encoding BOM; precheck passes; store/registry/doc updates included.
in_scope: Execution finalization hardening: review-loop guards and AC/report edge cases
approach: Execution finalization hardening: review-loop guards and AC/report edge cases

assumptions: Delta review assumes fixes committed before review
Design pack source is item.design_pack; MD is generated
divergences: Prior re-review reviewed the full cumulative diff; this changes to delta+prior context.
